description: Issue 3: Language switcher ('日本語' / 'かんたん日本語') shows the correct selector value but UI text does NOT change. Root cause: (a) handleLocaleChange in Header.tsx calls i18n.changeLanguage(nextLocale) DIRECTLY after also calling setLocale(nextLocale) — setLocale already calls i18n.changeLanguage internally, creating a double invocation that can cause the languageChanged event to not propagate correctly to react-i18next's subscription. (b) i18n is initialized without react.useSuspense:false, which can interfere with language-change re-renders. Fix: remove the duplicate call and add useSuspense:false.
steps: Edit app/src/components/layout/Header.tsx: in handleLocaleChange (around line 20-26), remove the line 'void i18n.changeLanguage(nextLocale)' — only 'setLocale(nextLocale)' should remain. The store is the single source of truth for language changes. Also remove the import 'import i18n from "@/i18n"' at the top of the file since it is no longer used directly in Header.tsx.

Edit app/src/i18n/index.ts: inside the .init({...}) options object add a 'react' field: react: { useSuspense: false }. This prevents react-i18next from attempting to suspend during language transitions when translations are already loaded synchronously.
